thread:
Maria K: Heads up — noticed an unusual drop in KV cache compactness for long sessions over the last 6h. Residency for sessions >250 tokens went from ~92% to ~65% on a subset of nodes. Heap growth correlates with session length. Link: https://dash.redwood/kv/compactness?range=6h :thinking_face:

Jon P: ugh. did eviction counters spike at the same time? any change in sampling rate or rollout?

Maria K: eviction_count went up ~3x on the impacted workers, but eviction_age histogram shows a lot of small fragments being evicted (<=4 pages). sampling rate for kvcache telemetry unchanged (1/100). no deploys in that window except a small kernel selection tweak at 05:12 UTC.

Anu R: can you paste the query you used? i'll try to reproduce against prod-sample.

Maria K: sure — the quick ad-hoc:
```
SELECT bucket, avg(residency) as residency, sum(evictions) as evs
FROM kv_metrics
WHERE session_len > 250 AND ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
```
results: bucket[200-400] residency 65%, evs +3.1x.

Priya S: Attach logs from one impacted worker? i want to see fragmentation pattern and whether reuse heatmap shows a hot window shift.

Maria K: pasted a tiny snippet from worker-23.log:
```
2026-03-17T05:14:03Z INFO kvcache: page_alloc size=4096 id=0x7ff2 frag=3 reuse=0
2026-03-17T05:14:03Z INFO kvcache: page_free id=0x7ff2 reason=evict age=12 reuse_hits=0
2026-03-17T05:14:04Z WARN kvcache: residency=0.62 sampling_rate=0.01
```

Jon P: hmm reuse_hits=0 lines up with lower reuse. Could be the kernel selection tweak changed allocation alignment leading to fragmentation. The change at 05:12 was a fallback order tweak for fp16 kernels — maybe different page alignment or larger immediate allocations.

Anu R: i can run a micro-bench to check allocation patterns before/after kernel tweak. also recommend we add an eviction_reason tag (already mentioned before) and a frag_size histogram to the telemetry. right now eviction counter is too coarse to diagnose small-page churn.

Priya S: For immediate mitigation — can we increase prefix/KV cache sampling to 1/10 for the affected pool and enable per-worker eviction_reason? i can coordinate a short rollout.

Maria K: +1. Also propose an alert: if residency drop >15% for bucket with session_len>200 and eviction_rate >2x baseline within 15m, page an eng-runtime oncall.

sre-bot: deploy request queued: toggle-telemetry-sampling -> prod/kvpool-3 (by Priya S). ETA 3m.

Jon P: i'll also revert the kernel-order tweak on a single canary host and compare compactness/residency. if that correlates we should treat as regression on allocation behavior.

Anu R: ran microbench locally — observed higher small-fragment allocations with the new fallback order. sending diff and perf traces.

Maria K: great. action list: (1) Priya increase sampling + eviction_reason on kvpool-3 (in flight), (2) Jon canary revert kernel order on h23, (3) Anu run profiling across a few session lengths and produce frag_size histogram, (4) add the alert rule for residency drop. i'll update the dashboard with a stacked eviction-reason/frag-size panel.

Priya S: rollout completed for kvpool-3 sampling=1/10 and eviction_reason=true. monitoring now.

sre-bot: alert created: eng-runtime.kv.residency_drop (threshold: 15% drop for bucket>200 within 15m).

Maria K: monitoring shows residency recovering on kvpool-3 to ~88% after sampling and config change. keeping an eye for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
